title: Affine direct-image Hom-complex comparison and counit compatibility
statement: With the notation and hypotheses of lem-sc-affine-hom-complex-evaluation, for every complex I and every chosen natural isomorphism e: Hom-complex(O_Y[0],-) ≅ 𝟭, there is a chain isomorphism d:T(H(I)) ≅ Hom-complex(f_*O_X[0],I) whose composite with precomposition by O_Y → f_*O_X and e_I is the termwise adjunction counit.

proof.text: Identify the restriction of the direct-image algebra unit with f_*O_X, project the Hom-complex product to source degree zero, and define d degreewise by the resulting internal-Hom isomorphisms.
The assumed sectionwise counit evaluation gives the required composite equality; extensionality on opens, sections, and chain maps finishes.
